topic: Medicine cabinet check-up before winter (expiry, storage, safe disposal)
headline: Medicine cabinet
intro: Cold season is here. Take 10 minutes to get your cabinet ready.

points.title: Check expiry dates
points.body: Expired products may not work as expected. Check every box and bottle in your cabinet.

points.title: Store it cool and dry
points.body: Bathroom heat and steam can affect medications. A cool, dry cupboard is usually a better spot.
points.tip: Keep items in their original packaging.

points.title: Keep it out of reach
points.body: Store medications up high and out of sight of children and pets.
points.tip: Close child-resistant caps all the way.

points.title: Return old medications
points.body: Don't flush them or toss them in the garbage. Bring unused or expired medications to us.

cta_body: Bring them in and we'll dispose of them safely.
caption_instagram:
4 medicine cabinet checks to do before winter 🧰

Cold season is here, so take 10 minutes this week: check expiry dates on everything (cough and cold items too), store medications somewhere cool and dry instead of a steamy bathroom, keep them up high and out of reach of kids and pets, and bring unused or expired medications to your pharmacy for safe disposal.
